scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: prisma generate && next typegen frontend && next typegen backend && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --project backend/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:auth: prisma generate && tsx database/scripts/prepare-test-database.ts && tsx --test backend/tests/auth.test.ts
scripts.test:auth:http: prisma generate && tsx database/scripts/prepare-test-database.ts && tsx --test backend/tests/auth-http.test.ts
scripts.test:authorization: prisma generate && tsx database/scripts/prepare-test-database.ts && tsx --test backend/tests/authorization.test.ts
scripts.test:database: prisma generate && tsx database/scripts/prepare-test-database.ts && tsx --test database/tests/database.test.ts
scripts.test:operations: prisma generate && tsx database/scripts/prepare-test-database.ts && tsx --test backend/tests/operations.test.ts
